notes.title: New Demo Update 0-21f1 available!
notes.content:
Good news everyone!

We pushed a demo-update for INU based on your playtesting and feedback.

Especially for the Next Fest we unlocked two more fractals that you can find by playing again!
But we have added even more:

new features:

 screenshot synchronisation over Steam (limited functionality see Log [F3])
 three demo-fractal-adresses are now available
 tracklist near portal more diverse


bug-fixes:

 german instruction text (swapped left and right) now corrected
 loading of sound files optimized to avoid screen-freezes during loading
 introduced slow motion time near metaverse portals to avoid fly through
 increased slow motion time near mesoskop portal
 zoomer-intro soundchannel optimisation (rocket volume control, fade durations, fade exponents)


And as always, thanks for playing! <3
